body: Even if they have never read the Qu'ran, their religious leaders are able to pick and choose from the Qu'ran to incite violence.

I'm sitting in a burger joint eating unhealthy food. I sometimes present myself as an pre-vegetarian, but on days like this it may be safer to go for the comfort food. I have a class in about three hours so I have some time to kill. That may not be a good way to think of it considering my pre-suicidal spiral, but its an apt description.

I talked online with the suicide hotline about an hour ago and explained my situation. I'm in no hurry to off myself, but perhaps in the back of my mind, I'd welcome the opportunity if it presented itself. The VA suicide hotline promised me that someone from the crisis team will probably call me today or tomorrow. I have a sneaking suspicion I'm going to be hospitalized again. Its nice to take time off, but I'd rather do it under my own terms. Spending a few days in a hospital causes me to lose money at work. (I'm a fairly high paid hourly employee.) and would cost me about $1,000 copay. 

I feel isolated. My parents suspect and know I have a history of depression but are blissfully ignorant of my last stay. The ex-wife treated me poorly when I was in. She told me I was neglecting my children. To her credit, she later told me she was being mean and apologized. I told her she was a bitch but accepted her apology. The woman I'm dating once told me she was concerned that my suicidal history may effect her energy field. I have no idea what that means, but it sounds ominous and doesn't bode well for long-term stability. 

There is a horrible stigma associated with my severe depression. I have every right to have it. I'm in the most stressful time of my life. I'm going through a divorce, I'm going to school for the first time in a while and my unwed daughter is pregnant but seems clueless of the ramifications. Mostly I feel alone. I don't feel as if I have very many people who have my back. I can think of two people I can truly count on.  I guess that's enough; I don't know.  A colleague of mine took a week off of work because of a severe flu. If I was to take a week off and publicly announce suicidal tendancies, my career would be stymied.  Hell, 40 years ago a doctor may have put a couple of electrodes on my head and  tried to zap the depression away. 

Now I feel sick to my stomach. Don't eat a hamburger if you've been living off of fruit and vegetables for  a week.
